comicPageDescriptions.text: A worried reader in a blue hoodie faces a desktop Project Proposal; a tablet is marked Too small and a phone Static. His speech bubble says the document only works on one screen. The caption says old documents are static and hard to use everywhere.

A smiling reader gives a thumbs-up beside laptop, tablet and phone layouts joined by green arrows. The illustration labels PRD Portable + Responsive + Interactive and shows icons for an interactive chart, comments and offline sync.
Three scenes show a reader holding a phone, a small team around a shared screen, and a reader using a laptop in a cafe. Labels in the illustration read Live updates, Collaboration and Works offline.
